violations.why: Main reads the global at line 25 as the argument, then the ISR sets it to 0, then main re-reads it at line 35 inside the guarded branch, so the checked value is stale.
Main's increment at line 35 reads the global and then writes it back. If the ISR writes 0 in between, main overwrites it with the stale value plus 1, so the ISR's update is lost.
